name: strictgen
description: One JSON Schema. Strict Rust, Go and TypeScript types and decoders that accept and reject exactly the same JSON.
author: Sahid Hossen

scripts.examples: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js generate --config examples/basic/strictgen.json && node dist/cli.js generate --config examples/report/strictgen.json && node dist/cli.js generate --config examples/llm/strictgen.json
scripts.examples:check: pnpm build && node dist/cli.js check --config examples/basic/strictgen.json && node dist/cli.js check --config examples/report/strictgen.json && node dist/cli.js check --config examples/llm/strictgen.json
